## Plugin reference

- Description: Shared web infra for attachment-owning page blocks: <AttachmentUpload>, the empty state — attachments' UploadDropzone wired to the block (Enter / Space open its picker through useBlockActivate, paste armed while the caret is on it). Owns the single block↔attachment link (page_blocks_attachments) and one generic reconcile bound to blocksChanged; FK cascade reclaims on delete.
- Server:
  - Contributes:
    - `resource.declare` "page.block-attachment-links"
    - `resource.declare` "page.block-attachment-links:rows"
    - `attachments.link` "page_blocks"
    - `trigger` "page.attachment-block.reconcile"
  - Uses:
    - `database.db`
    - `infra/attachments.Attachments`
    - `infra/events.eventField`
    - `infra/events.Trigger`
    - `infra/jobs.defineJob`
    - `network/live.serveCollection`
    - `page/editor._blocks`
    - `page/editor.BLOCKS_CHANGED_SETTLE`
    - `page/editor.blocksChanged`
    - `page/editor.liveBlocks`
  - DB schema: `plugins/page/plugins/attachment-block/server/internal/tables.ts`
  - Exports (types): `BlockAttachmentCollector`
  - Exports (values): `AttachmentBlock`
  - Register: `defineJob('page.attachment-block.reconcile')`
  - Resources:
    - `page.block-attachment-links` (keyed)
    - `page.block-attachment-links:rows` (keyed, point)
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/attachments/upload-dropzone.UploadDropzone`
    - `infra/attachments/upload-dropzone.UploadDropzoneHandle`
    - `page/editor.useBlockActivate`
  - Exports (values): `AttachmentUpload`
- Core:

- Cross-plugin:
